from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import re

model = Path("sysml-models/hall-sensored-bldc/model.sysml")
source = model.read_text()
old = "attribute :>> speedControlTicksPerUpdate = 20;"
new = "attribute :>> speedControlTicksPerUpdate = 200;"
if source.count(old) != 1:
    raise SystemExit("expected exactly one controller interval parameter")
source = source.replace(old, new)
model.write_text(source)

def body(text, start, end):
    return text.split(start, 1)[1].split(end, 1)[0]

safety_slice = "\n--SLICE--\n".join((
    body(source, "part def NominalAveragedTwoPhaseMotorPlant",
         "part def HallSensorAndSpeedEstimator"),
    body(source, "part def HallCommutatedDrive", "part def SpeedController"),
    body(source, "part def SpeedController",
         "part def HallSensoredBrushlessMotorSystem"),
    body(source, "part def HallSensoredBrushlessMotorSystem", "part system"),
))
digest = hashlib.sha256(safety_slice.encode()).hexdigest()
verification = Path("hall_motor_verification.py")
verification_source = verification.read_text()
verification_source, replacements = re.subn(
    r'(?<=EXPECTED_SAFETY_SLICE_SHA256 = \(\n    ")[0-9a-f]{64}',
    digest,
    verification_source,
)
if replacements != 1:
    raise SystemExit("failed to pin the experimental safety-slice digest")
verification.write_text(verification_source)
print("controller_decision_interval_seconds=0.01")
